content: Tmijja tamezwarut: Wenni izeddɣen deg udurri n Umɛuǧi x kuřci, aqa netta ad issens di tiři n Umzemmar x kuřci.
Tmijja wiss tnayen: Ad iniɣ i SIDI: Cek d amcan inu n tarewřa d lburj inu, AREBBI inu, Wenni x ttecřeɣ!
Tmijja tamezwarut: Maɣar Netta ad cek ifekk zi řfex n ineymaren n ijḍaḍ, zi ṭṭaɛun yareddǧen.
S arric nnes ad cek ideř, sadu wafriwen nnes ad tafed adurri. Řmanet nnes d taseddart tameqqrant d arruḍ n wuzzař.
War tᵉtteggʷeded ca zeg unexřiɛ n ǧiřet, zi fřitca n řqews i din iṭṭawen s wass,
uřa zi ṭṭaɛun i dd-ittennḍen di taǧest, zi lhalak i yareddǧen s uziř.
Waxxa ad wḍan ařef ɣar uɣezdis nnec u ɛecra ařef ɣar afus afusi nnec, ɛad war cek dd-ittikkʷiḍ.
Ad twařid aya s tiṭṭawin nnec waha, ad tẓared mammec ɣa ittwaxřef zeg iɛeffanen.
Tmijja wiss tnayen: Maɣar xak: ‘Cek a SIDI, aqa Cek d amcan inu n tarewřa!’
Tmijja tamezwarut Aqa cek teggid Amɛuǧi x kuřci d tazeddiɣt i yixef nnec,
war dayek tneṭṭeḥ tuɛeffna, uřa d ict n jjriḥect war dd-tqarrab ca ɣar uqiḍun nnec,
maɣar Netta ad xak yumur lmalakat nnes, maḥend ad cek ḥḍant di marra ibriden nnec.
Ad cek ksin x ifassen nsent, ḥima aḍar nnec war ineggeḥ aẓru.
Ad tɛefsed x weyrad izehharen u x třefsa, ad tɛejned x weyrad ameẓyan d řhaycet n řebḥar.
Tmijja wiss třata zi Arebbi: Umi dd-iqqen netta ɣari, Necc ad t ssnejmeɣ. Necc ad t ssgeɛɛdeɣ, maɣar netta issen Isem inu.
Netta ad ayi iřaɣa u Necc ad xas dd-arreɣ. Di řeḥṣaret aqa ayi ɣares. Necc ad t fekkeɣ, ad as ssɛuǧeɣ.
Necc ad t ssjjiwneɣ ak-d tuzzeggart n wussan, Necc ad as ssecneɣ asenjem inu.
